note: Truman Lake Corps campground on a point beside Osage Bluff Marina. The inner sites sit under cedars; the outer pads on the south and west rim look down an open mown slope to the lake, some 10 m below. Long paved back-in pads throughout. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on rec.gov: 60 sites, 56 electric (50A on 15-32, 30A on the rest), 25 with water; season Mar 1-Nov 30; fees $14-35; 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday minimums. Stored pin is 1.5 km off, in roadless forest: move proposed. Lake is plainly in view from the rim sites; lakefront upgrade candidate. Phone to add.
flags: PIN MOVE (1.5 km): stored 38.1906,-93.3933 is the rec.gov facility point; on imagery it is unbroken forest on a different point, two coves north-west of the campground, with no road. Every catalog site lies within 38.1816-38.1848, -93.3811 to -93.3776. Proposed 38.18290,-93.37940 (the bathhouse at the middle of the loops).

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview) - the lake IS in view, and this is an UPGRADE CANDIDATE to lakefront, owner's call: on the 0.27 m/px leaf-off frame about nine pads on the outer side of the loop road (the south arc, catalog points 39, 41, 42, 45, 46, 48, 49, and the west circle, 20-22) sit 25-45 m from the water's edge with nothing between but mown grass and three or four isolated trees - no road, no timber belt. Against: the pads are on the rim of the point, about 228 m by DEM against a 215 m normal pool (706 ft), so roughly 10-13 m above the water on an open slope (the 90 m DEM is coarse); rec.gov carries no 'Proximity to Water' attribute; site photos were not viewed; and the imagery date and pool level that day are unknown (Truman is a flood-control pool). The inner ~45 sites are under cedars with at best a partial view. Not downgraded; lakeview is at least earned.
discounts.military is true from the Good Sam directory (derived) and was left alone; rec.gov's militaryDiscount rule flag was not used as evidence.

The rec.gov rules record carries minWeekendStay 0 / 'soft', but the facility notice states the 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday minimums in words; the notice was followed.
